content: [![](https://assets.lieonstudios.dev/common/badges/label/lieon-studios-creation.svg)](https://modrinth.com/organization/lieonstudios) [![](https://assets.lieonstudios.dev/common/badges/label/requires/quad.svg)](https://modrinth.com/mod/quad) 社群： [![discord](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/discord.svg)](https://discord.lieonlion.dev/) 原始碼： [![github](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/github.svg)](https://github.com/pnk2u/More-Feeding-Trough-Variants) pnku： [![pnku.de](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/shared/pres/icon/pnku_de_logo.svg)](https://www.pnku.de) [![modrinth](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/modrinth.svg)](https://modrinth.com/user/pnku) [![curseforge](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LieOnLion/LieOnLion/main/images/badges/buttons/curseforge.svg)](https://www.curseforge.com/members/pnku/) ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/shared/pres/desc_hr_top.svg) **注意**：本模組基於 [Slexom](https://modrinth.com/user/Slexom) 的 [動物餵食槽](https://modrinth.com/mod/animal_feeding_trough) 與我的 [更多堆肥箱變體](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-composter-variants)，運行此模組需同時安裝這兩個模組。 ## 更多餵食槽變體 為您的建築增添更多色彩繽紛的餵養方式，現在每種木材皆擁有專屬的餵食槽。 ![](https://uwu.catgirl.host/i/e69j1.gif) ### 為 Minecraft 新增 12 種全新的 _動物餵食槽_ ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pnk2u/resources/main/ModProjects/shared/pres/desc_hr_bottom.svg) [**![](https://uwu.catgirl.host/i/ocqi2.gif)**]()
